## Personality

Grandma Irving is an excellent woman who possesses a strict nature. She firmly expects those around her to follow her instructions and do as she tells them.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)_

## History

Grandma Irving lived in a home where she cared for her imaginative grandson, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), and welcomed [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a visitor. When Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), returned, Grandma Irving entertained [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her house, where Stephen asked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pass a message to his former love, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Her home subsequently became part of the broader story that brought Stephen and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) back together, culminating in their wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P4](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0004), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P7](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0007), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P8](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0008), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P9](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0009), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P11](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0011), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P12](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0012), +97 more_

## Relationships

### [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--mary-joe.md)

Grandma Irving employs and commands [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) within her household. [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) assists with domestic duties during visits from local guests like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). - Commands  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

Grandma Irving is the grandmother of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), providing a home for him where he lives and hosts visitors like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She manages the household where [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) grows up and shares his imaginative ideas with guests. Their home serves as a central setting for Paul's upbringing until his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), returns to reconnect with the family.

- Relative of — grandmother  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024), +3 more</sub>
